description: This PHP source file defines the 'Upgrade' class within the OpenCart admin tool module, handling the version upgrade process including checking for updates, downloading new versions, and installing updates.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the upgrade process of the OpenCart system, including checking for latest versions, downloading update packages, and installing updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the upgrade page with current version info, latest version retrieved from server, and UI components.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the download of a specified version archive from the GitHub repository, with permission and version validation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation of the downloaded update archive by unzipping and copying files to the appropriate directories.
